title: Act: Add getWorld client and show the World title in AdminApp
summary: Fetch the World and render its title in the heading
description: Add getWorld to the API client and use it in AdminApp to show the title.
acceptance_criteria: AdminApp heading shows the title, falling back to WORLD_ID.

steps.action: Add exported interface World {id: string; title: string} and exported async function getWorld(worldId: string = WORLD_ID) that fetches the public world endpoint and returns readJSON<World>(res), after getCurrentRound.
steps.expected: getWorld resolves with the parsed world and throws ApiError on non-2xx.

steps.action: Import getWorld from ../api/client; add state const [worldTitle, setWorldTitle] = useState<string | undefined>(undefined) after maxContributions state; in the first useEffect, also call getWorld(WORLD_ID).then(w => { if (!cancelled) setWorldTitle(w.title); }, () => {}) ; change the h1 to render Admin · {worldTitle ?? WORLD_ID}.
steps.expected: Heading shows the title once loaded and WORLD_ID before or on failure.
